Chuppi mein bramhand hai.
Grit jazba aur lagaataar mehnat hai.
Silence ko emptiness mat samjho.
Grit grit hi hai.
Bohot defeats mil sakte, par defeated nahi hona.
Grit keep going ki determination hai.
Himmat contagious kindness hai.
Manzil ke liye dard seho.
Khamoshi spirit ko train karti.
Khamoshi bolne se zyada safe hai.
Shaant logon ke dimaag shor karte hain.
Yeh maayne nahi rakhta ki aap kitna dheere chal rahe hain, bas rukna mat.
Grit talent nahi; strategy hai.
Grit dil ki chup-chap lagan hai.
Fortitude endurance ke saath courage hai.
Jo tumhe impossible lagta—wo kaam tumhe karna padega.
Courage measure hota hai jo aap karte.
Himmat ek faisla hai, baar-baar.
Khamoshi auron ke liye panah ban sakti.
Strong minds ideas discuss karte—weak minds logon pe atke.
Quiet logon ke paas sabse loud minds hote hain.
Khamoshi emptiness nahi.
